On a funded account you may not risk more than 50% of your daily loss limit on the same instrument in one trading day. A 3% daily loss limit means 1.5% on that instrument, 4% means 2%, and 5% means 2.5%. Example: a 2-Step $100,000 account has a $2,500 limit. Trades of $1,000 and $1,500 on the same instrument reach that limit.

Misal: 2-Step $100,000 account ki had $2,500 hai. Ek hi instrument par $1,000 aur $1,500 ki trades us had tak pahunch jati hain.

After a soft breach on a funded account, the account is not closed. The current payout is still processed at a 30% reward share, and the payout cycle restarts from payout 1, which also restarts the fee-refund count. If it happens again after the warning, the account can be reset and its profit forfeited. In evaluation, the team may reset the account using a free retry if you still have one.

Funded account par soft breach ke baad account band nahi hota. Mojooda payout 30% reward share par phir bhi process hota hai, aur payout cycle payout 1 se dobara shuru hota hai, jis se fee refund ki ginti bhi dobara shuru hoti hai. Agar warning ke baad yeh dobara ho to account reset ho sakta hai aur us ka profit forfeit ho jata hai. Evaluation mein team free retry se account reset kar sakti hai agar woh abhi maujood ho.

After a soft breach on a funded account, the account is not closed. The current payout is still processed at a 30% reward share, and the payout cycle restarts from payout 1, which also restarts the fee-refund count. If it happens again after the warning, the account can be reset and its profit forfeited. In evaluation, the team may reset the account using a free retry if you still have one.
Touching the daily loss limit or the max loss limit is a hard breach. A hard breach ends the account.

On a funded account you may not risk more than 50% of your daily loss limit on the same instrument in one trading day. A 3% daily loss limit means 1.5% on that instrument, 4% means 2%, and 5% means 2.5%. Example: a 2-Step $100,000 account has a $2,500 limit. Trades of $1,000 and $1,500 on the same instrument reach that limit.
